The production facility manufactures two types of products (Product 0 and Product 1) using two machines (Machine 0 and Machine 1) over four time periods (Period 0 to Period 3). The demand for Product 0 in Period 0 is **22.28694038228271**, in Period 1 is **15.40553617195959**, in Period 2 is **16.19622794603683**, and in Period 3 is **23.77133167016131**. A machine can only be started up for a product if it was not producing that product in the previous period.

    model.startup_logic = pyo.Constraint(
        model.M, model.P, model.T, rule=startup_rule
    )

    return model

def build_model(data=None):

    m.M = pyo.Set(initialize=d["machines"], ordered=True)   # machines
    m.T = pyo.Set(initialize=d["periods"], ordered=True)    # periods

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Decision variables
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # prod[p,m,t] >= 0 : quantity of product p produced on machine m in period t
    m.prod = pyo.Var(m.P, m.M, m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # inv[p,t] >= 0 : end-of-period inventory of product p
    m.inv = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # back[p,t] >= 0 : end-of-period backlog of product p
    m.back = pyo.Var(m.P, m.T, within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # assign[p,m,t] binary : machine m dedicated to product p in period t
    m.assign = pyo.Var(m.P, m.M, m.T, within=pyo.Binary)

    # setup[p,m,t] binary : a production run of product p on machine m in period t
    m.setup = pyo.Var(m.P, m.M, m.T, within=pyo.Binary)

    # startup[p,m,t] binary : machine m starts up for product p in period t
    m.startup = pyo.Var(m.P, m.M, m.T, within=pyo.Binary)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Objective: minimize total cost
    #   setup + startup + holding + backlogging
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def obj_rule(mm):
        setup_term = sum(
            d["setup_cost"] * mm.setup[p, mc, t]
            for p in mm.P for mc in mm.M for t in mm.T
        )
        startup_term = sum(
            d["startup_cost"] * mm.startup[p, mc, t]
            for p in mm.P for mc in mm.M for t in mm.T
        )
        hold_term = sum(
            d["hold_cost"][p] * mm.inv[p, t]
            for p in mm.P for t in mm.T
        )
        back_term = sum(
            d["back_cost"][p] * mm.back[p, t]
            for p in mm.P for t in mm.T
        )
        return setup_term + startup_term + hold_term + back_term

    m.obj = pyo.Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=pyo.minimize)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint 1: Inventory / backlog balance for each product and period
    #   inv[p,t-1] - back[p,t-1] + sum_m prod[p,m,t]
    #       - inv[p,t] + back[p,t] = demand[p,t]
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def balance_rule(mm, p, t):
        prev_inv = mm.inv[p, t - 1] if t > 0 else 0.0
        prev_back = mm.back[p, t - 1] if t > 0 else 0.0
        production = sum(mm.prod[p, mc, t] for mc in mm.M)
        return (prev_inv - prev_back + production
                - mm.inv[p, t] + mm.back[p, t]) == d["demand"][p][t]

    m.balance = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.T, rule=balance_rule)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint 2: At most one product per machine per period
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def one_product_rule(mm, mc, t):
        return sum(mm.assign[p, mc, t] for p in mm.P) <= 1

    m.one_product = pyo.Constraint(m.M, m.T, rule=one_product_rule)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint 3: Production linked to assignment (big-M)
    #   prod[p,m,t] <= bigM * assign[p,m,t]
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def prod_link_rule(mm, p, mc, t):
        return mm.prod[p, mc, t] <= d["bigM"] * mm.assign[p, mc, t]

    m.prod_link = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.M, m.T, rule=prod_link_rule)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint 4: Setup linked to assignment
    #   assign[p,m,t] <= setup[p,m,t]
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def setup_link_rule(mm, p, mc, t):
        return mm.assign[p, mc, t] <= mm.setup[p, mc, t]

    m.setup_link = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.M, m.T, rule=setup_link_rule)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint 5: Startup definition
    #   startup[p,m,t] >= assign[p,m,t] - assign[p,m,t-1]
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def startup_rule(mm, p, mc, t):
        prev = mm.assign[p, mc, t - 1] if t > 0 else 0.0
        return mm.startup[p, mc, t] >= mm.assign[p, mc, t] - prev

    m.startup_def = pyo.Constraint(m.P, m.M, m.T, rule=startup_rule)

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Constraint 6: Machine capacity per period
    #   sum_p prod[p,m,t] + startup_time[m] * sum_p startup[p,m,t] <= capacity[m]
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def capacity_rule(mm, mc, t):
        total_prod = sum(mm.prod[p, mc, t] for p in mm.P)
        total_startup = sum(mm.startup[p, mc, t] for p in mm.P)
        return (total_prod + d["startup_time"][mc] * total_startup
                <= d["capacity"][mc])

    m.capacity = pyo.Constraint(m.M, m.T, rule=capacity_rule)

    return m

        # Use z summed over products, but each machine can only start once per period.

        return sum(m.a[mm, p, t] for p in m.products) <= 1

    m.one_product = pyo.Constraint(m.machines, m.periods, rule=one_product_rule)

    # Production of product p in t requires at least one machine assigned.
    def prod_link_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] <= d["M_big"] * sum(m.a[mm, p, t] for mm in m.machines)

    m.prod_link = pyo.Constraint(m.products, m.periods, rule=prod_link_rule)

    # Setup indicator must be 1 if any machine is assigned to product p in period t.
    def setup_link_rule(m, mm, p, t):
        return m.y[p, t] >= m.a[mm, p, t]

    m.setup_link = pyo.Constraint(m.machines, m.products, m.periods, rule=setup_link_rule)

    # Production only if setup is active.
    def prod_setup_rule(m, p, t):
        return m.x[p, t] <= d["M_big"] * m.y[p, t]

    m.prod_setup = pyo.Constraint(m.products, m.periods, rule=prod_setup_rule)

    # Startup definition: z[p,t] >= y[p,t] - y[p,t-1]. For t=0, prev y = 0.
    def startup_rule(m, p, t):
        prev_y = m.y[p, t - 1] if t > 0 else 0
        return m.z[p, t] >= m.y[p, t] - prev_y

    m.startup = pyo.Constraint(m.products, m.periods, rule=startup_rule)

    return m
